title: ClientError missing #[non_exhaustive] — adding variant is breaking change
description: ClientError has no #[non_exhaustive] attribute. Any downstream crate that matches exhaustively on ClientError will break if a new variant is added in a minor version. The crate intends to add variants (e.g. rate-limiting, streaming errors) as JMAP extensions are implemented. Without #[non_exhaustive], every such addition is a semver-breaking change. The in-crate exhaustive match test (client_error_no_rate_limited_variant) still works with #[non_exhaustive] — internal code can still match exhaustively — so adding the attribute costs nothing for the existing test but protects downstream callers.
